story_beats.speech: At the abandoned railway, Otter heard a warning bell ringing beneath the flooded tracks. The last ferry was approaching the broken crossing, and nobody knew who was ringing it.
Otter followed the sound along the platform. Every time the ferry's engine rumbled, the bell rang twice. She tied a ribbon to the old signal cable and watched it twitch with the water.
The bell wasn't a ghostly warning. A loose cable ran from the submerged signal post to the railway bell. Waves from the ferry pulled the cable, ringing it just as the boat neared the danger.

Otter raised a lantern and waved the ferry away from the broken crossing. Once everyone was safe, the neighbors marked the hazard and repaired the signal. The strange bell had been warning them all along.
